stories.title: Twenty-two social rent flats proposed for former Flint Working Men’s Club site
stories.summary: Twenty-two flats for social rent are proposed on the site of Flint’s former Working Men’s Club, which has stood empty since it was demolished around 2009. Tai Wales and West Housing has opened a pre-application consultation on the Woodfield Avenue scheme. A pre-application consultation is the stage where a developer has to show its plans

stories.title: Dee Estuary cockling rules face first rewrite in 18 years
stories.summary: The rules controlling who can gather cockles on the Dee Estuary are to be rewritten, with 54 licensed gatherers working under an order that expires in June 2028. stories.title: Hawarden now holds two of Wales’s biggest heat records after Met Office verification
stories.summary: Hawarden recorded the hottest June day ever in Wales, the Met Office has confirmed, with 35.1C on 26 June now verified as a national record. The figure was confirmed in a Met Office release published on Wednesday, following the verification process the service runs on any provisional record. It beats the previous Welsh June record

stories.summary: A man wanted by North Wales Police is in custody after an appeal posted on Facebook by the force’s North Flintshire policing team. stories.title: Never Events: Eleven preventable safety incidents at Betsi Cadwaladr in a year, more than any health board in Wales
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board recorded the highest number of “never events” in Wales last year, according to its latest annual report. The health board logged 11 new never events during 2025/26 – an increase of six compared with the previous year. The report states the Welsh health board with the second-highest total recorded seven.
